channel.title: plicara labs essays
channel.description: Essays and arguments from Adrian Tame’s independent AI research lab.

item.title: Pi profiles, part 2: Agents, plural
item.description: Pi is built around one minimal agent you shape yourself. I think the people who get deepest into it end up needing several, and that the work is moving from writing skills to designing the environment an agent runs in. That last part is a hypothesis, and I'd like to test it.

item.title: Pi profiles, part 1: a shelf for the agents you build
item.description: Pi lets you build your own agent, but it gives you nowhere to put it. I built a small launcher that keeps a separate Pi setup for each kind of work, with shared session history and one shared set of packages.

item.title: What I learned rebuilding Pi Audit Loop
item.description: A review and simplification loop found real bugs, but it also confused findings with repairs. I rebuilt it around one change, a checked revision and a final diff review.

item.title: The harness is the signal
item.description: As models improve, some of today's agent machinery will disappear. The parts that govern permissions, execution, recovery and accountability probably will not.
